In the fetal circulation the ductus arteriosus connects the pulmonary artery and the descending aor- ta. After birth, various mechanisms, including a fall in prosta- glandin concentration, trigger its closure but in some infants the ductus arteriosus fails to close, a condition known as persistent patent ductus arteriosus.
